**Entry 1.** Counterparty "Oskemen Rolling Mill LLP" is a designated RESTRICTED SUBSIDIARY of the Borrower. Relationship: Wholly owned operating subsidiary within the Borrower's Restricted Group. It is a member of the Restricted Group under the Facility.

**Entry 2.** Counterparty "Altai Ore Processing LLP" is a designated UNRESTRICTED SUBSIDIARY of the Borrower. Relationship: Operating subsidiary designated as UNRESTRICTED and accordingly falling outside the collateral perimeter of the Facility. It sits outside the Restricted Group; transfers of assets to this entity fall outside the Facility's covenant and collateral scope.

**Identification and Verification**

The client has been identified on the basis of its constitutional documents, certificate of registration and data obtained from official registers. The authority of persons acting on its behalf has been confirmed by corporate resolutions and identity documents.

Information supplied by the client has been reconciled against public registers. No discrepancy requiring further enquiry was identified. Copies of the verified documents are held on file.

**Sanctions and Watchlist Screening**

The client, its officers and its shareholders have been screened against international and national restrictive-measures lists and against lists of persons associated with the financing of terrorism. No match was returned.

Screening for politically exposed persons and their close associates has been carried out in respect of the officers and shareholders. Name-only matches were excluded on the basis of additional identifying attributes..
